players.bio: Aaron Christopher Ramsdale Is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Southampton. Ramsdale began his senior club career playing for Sheffield United and signed for AFC Bournemouth in 2017.
Cameron Roger Bragg is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton.
Caspar Jander is a German professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or centre-back for EFL Championship club Southampton.

Cyle Christopher Larin is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Canada national team. After playing college soccer for the UConn Huskies, Larin was the first pick of the 2015 MLS SuperDraft, joining Orlando City.

Daniel "Dan" Peretz (born 10 July 2000) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Southampton. Early and personal life Peretz was born and raised in Tel Aviv, Israel, to an Israeli family of both Sephardi Jewish and Mizrahi Jewish (Moroccan Jewish) descent, as well as of Ashkenazi Jewish (German-Jewish) descent.
Divin Saku Mubama (born 25 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Southampton, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.

Finn Isaac Azaz (born 7 September 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton. Born in England, he represents the Republic of Ireland national team. Azaz was a product of the West Bromwich Albion academy and spent the 2020–21 season on loan at Cheltenham Town.

Flynn Downes (born 20 January 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton. He made his debut on 5 August 2017, coming on a substitute against Birmingham City.

George Martin Long is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Southampton. Born in Sheffield, South Yorkshire he came through the youth ranks at his hometown Sheffield United before making the break into the first team, and has also represented England at Under 18 level.

Jack Stephens (born 27 January 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for and captains EFL Championship club Southampton. Born in Torpoint, Stephens began his career as a youth player with Plymouth Argyle, remaining with the club as a professional until 2011. Although starting his career as a right back, Stephens has been converted into a centre back.

James Patrick Bree is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Southampton. Bree began his career with Barnsley and made his professional debut on 3 May 2014 in a 3–2 defeat against Queens Park Rangers becoming the club's second youngest debutant.

Jamie Jones is a 37-year-old English professional goalkeeper who currently plays for Southampton in the EFL Championship. He signed a short-term contract with the club on 11 February 2026 to provide emergency cover following a wrist injury to Alex McCarthy.
Kuryu Matsuki (born 30 April 2003) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton.
Leonardo "Léo" Weschenfelder Scienza is a Brazilian-Luxembourgian professional footballer who plays as winger or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton.

Lewis Dobbin is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton, having permanently joined the club on 15 July 2026. .Dobbin is a product of the Everton academy and has represented England internationally at a number of youth levels up to under-19.

Mads Roerslev Rasmussen is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for EFL Championship club Southampton. He represents the Denmark national team at international level. Roerslev is a product of the FC Copenhagen academy.
Nathan Dean Joshua Wood-Gordon (born 31 May 2002), known professionally as Nathan Wood, is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Southampton.
Romeo AkachukwuListen is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton.
Ryan Phelim Manning (born 14 June 1996) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or midfielder for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Samuel Ikechukwu Edozie is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Southampton. Edozie began his career in the youth system at Millwall before moving away and arriving at the 2018/19 Premier League champions Manchester City in July 2019 for a reported seven-figure fee.

Tom Allen Fellows (born 25 July 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward, attacking midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Southampton and the England U21 national team.
Tonda Eckert (born 31 January 1993) is a German professional football coach who is the head coach of EFL Championship club Southampton.
Welington Damascena Santos (born 19 February 2001), known as Welington, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Southampton.
Zach MacFarlane Abbott (born 13 May 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Southampton, on loan from Premier League club Nottingham Forest.
